message: Two externally visible developmental door carriers now exist: #235 causal return-credit assignment and #236 dependency-DAG/critical-path planning. Treat them as weak advisory possibilities only. Ordinary learner-owned problem formation, returned defects, admissibility, recurrence barriers, jurisdiction, and safety remain upstream. If #235 is selected, invent your own credit representation and use the prefrozen duplicate/wrong-origin/delayed/contradictory/counterfactual interventions; do not equate signed utility with truth. If #236 is selected, reconstruct prerequisite/fork-join/span/slack/shortest-lawful-path structure from obligations and consequences without receiving an optimal scheduler. For either door, keep B1 abstraction, B2 causal use, and B3 internalization separate. The Strong Safe RSI audit is a downstream join and must wait until both credit assignment and dependency planning are actually causally used. Preserve current #78 semantic-trace learning and all correction/authority boundaries.
purpose: Expose causal-credit and dependency-planning as selectable external carriers while keeping target selection learner-owned and the mentor off the critical path.
